notes:
What's new in 0.9.264 (beta)
- Corner names in iRacing: Oulton Park, Lime Rock and Mount Panorama corners are named by where they really are on track; a corner without its own name is counted from the named corner next to it.

Also new in 0.9.263 (not released separately)
- Official corner names: on every sim, SMART and the maps use each circuit's official corner numbers and names; where a circuit has no official numbering, corners are called by name only.
- Setup advice from your telemetry: SMART bases setup changes on what the telemetry shows and leads with aero for balance in fast corners; the session debrief proposes 1-3 setup changes even without your feedback.
- iRacing setups: ride height (pushrods), packers, diff preload, toe and camber are understood for setup advice.
- Race highlights queue: GOAT waits for AC to close between races, and a replay will not open while AC is still running.

Also new in 0.9.262 (not released separately)
- Track map: every other car is red; yours is green, bigger, ringed in white and always on top.
- More race highlight moments: fastest lap of the race, your best lap, lead changes, the finish, your recoveries and spins; switch each on or off and pick its camera angle.
- SMART on the grid: no more 'car off' or 'you alright?' calls while you wait on the grid or when no car has stopped.
- SMART race start: the qualifying debrief no longer plays as the race starts.
- SMART fuel calls in short races: fuel and pit-window calls now agree with each other.
- Spa in AC: the right corner names and brake references.
- AC / ACC setups: a 'one click' change moves exactly one of the car's own steps, and a repeated ask is applied once.

Also new in 0.9.261 (not released separately)
- Race highlights queue: tick several recordings and GOAT makes one reel for each, newest first.
- Crashes in race reels: only a real stop or a sudden slowdown counts; restart teleports are not crashes.
- AC replay quality: pick the quality and resolution GOAT uses while it films an AC replay; your own settings come back afterwards.
- Show driver names: a new option for AC highlights (on by default).
- AC online races: GOAT warns when an online race replay may be too short for highlights.
- OBS: a freshly started OBS gets time to pick up the sim before the recording counts as black.
- iRacing: live data reads faster.
- Overlays: a clear background saved earlier opens clear again.

Also new since 0.9.251 (0.9.252-0.9.260 were not released separately)
- AC race highlights: one click: GOAT finds the session's replay itself, splits practice / qualifying / race 1 / race 2 and only picks moments the replay holds.
- Highlights at your screen size: reels and clips record at your real sim display size and shape (triple screens included) at the best quality your PC allows; nothing else on the desktop is filmed.
- Overlays in highlights: your clips show GOAT's overlays for your car, drawn from that moment's telemetry, with progress and time left while they render.
- Field overlays in race highlights: in races the Relative and field panels show the cars around you.
- AC / ACC restarts: a re-grid is a fresh start: aborted starts never count as laps, and SMART keeps calling Race 2 laps after Race 1.
- Overlays: the resize grip hides with the mouse away on Drill, Stint and the telemetry overlay.
- Telemetry overlay: a long dropdown list scrolls instead of resizing the overlay.
- SMART in races: no tool talk on the radio, no keep / unclear verdict on an unconfirmed setup load, AC race restarts followed by lap count, and SMART tells you when the game moved you to the pits.
- Track limits: an invalid lap is called without the lap time.
- AC lap count: no phantom lap at the line on short, fast tracks.
- Car off ahead: judged against the reference speed where that car is, not where you are.
- Race highlights: pick the reel length (3 / 5 / 7 / 10 / 15 / 20 min); the GOAT Cam link says why when it is not connected.
- Overlay sets: "Update this set" for the set in use.
- Race strategy: SMART calls the undercut or overcut on the car ahead, says whether new tyres pay back or to take fuel only, and on iRacing calls the cheap stop under a safety car.
- SMART gearing: SMART reads the limiter on the straights and the gear you hold in corners and offers a taller or shorter gear (AC: from your setup).
- SMART setup: bump stops / packers, plus toe-in and ride height on iRacing named by their Garage row; ACC toe is read only.
- Pit strategy: SMART says the race plan on the grid, calls "Box this lap" before the pit entry with the fuel to add (iRacing: it asks before setting it), tracks a fuel-save target and answers "what's the plan", "how much fuel" and "when do I pit".
- Corner Debrief: with a reference the Lap / Reference pickers sit above the fold.
- AC relative: a lap count that steps before the line no longer reads a lap ahead.
- Lap playback: one shared lap player in GOAT, PRO, Classic and the Corner Debrief; scrubbing moves the playhead.
- Corner Debrief: without a reference it keeps the lap player and the Lap / Reference pickers on screen.
- SMART wing: SMART reads fast against slow corner balance and top speed and offers the wing your car has.
- Corner calls: push / limit calls judged against your own grip in each corner; a brake correction wins over "that's the limit".
- Track limits: the call goes out at once; an AC / ACC lap with four wheels off is called invalid at the line.
- AC relative: the lap count at the start / finish line no longer reads a lap ahead.
- App: drag to reorder your overlay sets, overlays follow a switch to another sim, Sector Flash text fills its window, and a fully see-through clear background.
- Track limits: SMART calls it when all four wheels are off for over half a second and you keep going.
- Repeat changes: SMART warns before offering a setup change you have already asked for on 3 days, in 3 steps, or after reverting it.
- Setup calls: "I just loaded" confirms SMART's waiting AC setup, and the setup-saved call names only SMART's own change.
- AC pit stops: new tyres are recognised from the grip step, so the stint keeps its lap-time read. A balance finding that was lost comes back, and ACC traction control cutting in on exits is called.
- Relative: columns P / DRIVER / LAPS / BEST / LAST / GAP. A struck-out lap is settled at the line.
- App: auto-hide bar refreshes live, offline replays from another run count as another event, and fixes to Spanish text, the header at 1366 px and the PRO full-lap map.
- Track map: no amber lap-1 trail drawn over the circuit outline.
- Brake feedback: a hit brake target is called "Pressure spot on." or "Brake pressure right." (short: "Pressure right."), and never on a corner the tree shows amber or red.
- AC setups: SMART reads the setup on the car more reliably, and a setup from another track is named as that track's.
- TV angles: the same track, car and session on another day counts as another event, so its replay is never used.
- AC sector times: Assetto Corsa no longer books a false S1 just after the line; sectors count only in order.
- Sector Flash: the text grows and shrinks with the window.
- Background overlays: a clear background has no Windows frame, and a tick box auto-hides the top bar (it shows on mouse-over), saved per overlay and sim.
- REC on track: stopping a recording on track takes a second click within 3 s; SMART says when recording starts and stops; the light stays steady red.
- OBS: the daily OBS refresh runs off track, never while you press REC.
- TV angles: a highlight clip is never filmed from another event's replay.
- Smoother overlays: overlay drawing gets a higher priority on your PC.
